theme.designMd:
# Smart Teacher — Teacher
Material 3 portrait mobile at 390×844. Calm, professional, information-dense teacher surface with no mascot. Use only #FFFFFF, #E3F2FD, #90CAF9, #2196F3, #0D47A1 and neutral text #12263A/#5B6B7B/#93A2B0. Semantic colors only: #2E7D32 success, #F9A825 warning, #D32F2F error. No purple, teal, pink, orange, or decorative green. Differentiate subjects with icons and blue tint tiles (#E3F2FD, #D0E7FB, #B8DBF9, #A1CFF7, #90CAF9), never new hues. Fredoka headings and Nunito UI/body. Cards 20px radius, sheets 28px top radius, buttons 16px, chips fully rounded, 4pt spacing, 20px screen padding, 12px gaps, soft blue shadow rgba(13,71,161,.08) 0 8px 24px. White page. Flat rounded-vector illustrations only when useful, never photos. Touch targets at least 48×48 and body text at least 15px. No progress, percentages, streaks, points, XP, badges, leaderboards, bookmarks, or continue-watching UI. Motion: smooth, restrained 180–220ms with standard easing; preserve scroll position between tabs and respect reduced motion.
